subject: Human Body
title: What Bones Are Made Of
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: What Bones Are Made Of.

hook.text: Bones feel like rock, but they're alive. Cut one open and you'll find blood vessels, nerves, and cells.

buildup.text: The outer layer is dense cortical bone. Inside is spongy bone full of tiny holes, like a honeycomb.

discovery.text: Bones are 70% mineral and 30% protein. Calcium gives hardness. Collagen gives flexibility.

twist.text: Without collagen, bones shatter like glass. Without minerals, they bend like rubber. You need both.

climax.text: Your skeleton replaces itself every ten years. The bones you have now didn't exist a decade ago.

punchline.text: Bones aren't dead scaffolding. They're alive and rebuilding.
